title: Elodie and the Letters
author: Silas Nystrom
blurb: Wren Winterbourne, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
